slides.headline: 6 FREE WEBSITES REPLACING TOOLS YOU STILL PAY FOR
slides.kicker: MOST PEOPLE HAVEN'T FOUND HALF OF THESE
slides.image_prompt: Open red metal toolbox on white table displays six glowing screens with dollar signs, warning triangles, and red crosses in bright daylight, shot from above.

slides.headline: 1) USE PHOTOSHOP FOR FREE IN YOUR BROWSER RIGHT NOW
slides.body: Adobe Photoshop costs $276 a year. Photopea does the same thing for free, in your browser, with no download. Go to photopea.com. Every tool is there: layers, masks, curves, the clone stamp.

slides.headline: 2) REMOVE ANY BACKGROUND IN TWO SECONDS FLAT
slides.body: Product photographers used to spend 20 minutes cutting out backgrounds by hand. Remove.bg does it the moment you drop the photo. Go to remove.bg. Drop your image. Download the PNG instantly.

slides.headline: 12 BILLION ACCOUNTS LEAKED ONLINE.
slides.body: Most people find out their passwords were stolen months after the damage is done. Go to haveibeenpwned.com. Type your email. It shows every breach your account appeared in.

slides.headline: 4) GET ANY RESEARCH QUESTION ANSWERED BY REAL PAPERS
slides.body: Instead of guessing what the science says, you can type any question and get an answer pulled from real science papers. Go to consensus.app. Every result links back to the actual paper.

slides.headline: 5) FIND EVERY SITE USING YOUR PHOTOS WITHOUT PERMISSION
slides.body: TinEye has indexed over 60 billion images to track exactly where your photos appear. Go to tineye.com. Upload a photo. If someone took your work, this finds them.

slides.headline: 6) DO EVERYTHING TO A PDF WITHOUT PAYING ANYTHING
slides.body: Adobe Acrobat Pro costs $240 a year to merge, split, compress, and sign PDFs. ILovePDF does all of it free, no account needed. Go to ilovepdf.com. Done in under a minute.

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: YOUR 6-WEBSITE HIDDEN TOOLBOX
slides.body:
Photopea: free Photoshop in your browser
Remove.bg: backgrounds vanish in 2 seconds
HaveIBeenPwned: check if your data leaked
Consensus: research questions answered instantly
TinEye: find who stole your photos
ILovePDF: every PDF task, free

caption:
Swipe to save all six ⚙️ Six free websites that together replace tools most people pay over $500 for every year.

1) Photopea, the free browser Photoshop that does everything the paid version does,
2) Remove.bg, which removes any background from a photo in two seconds,
3) HaveIBeenPwned, which shows every data breach your email has appeared in,
4) Consensus, which finds peer-reviewed research papers to answer any question you have,
5) TinEye, which finds every site that has ever used your photos without permission,
6) ILovePDF, which merges, splits, compresses, converts, and signs PDFs for free with no account needed.

Every one of these has been free for years. Most people skip them because they don't know they exist, and keep paying for the same jobs every month. None of them ask for an account to get started.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.
